requirements.summary: Fresh OpenShell sandbox dedicated to prime-agent, built directly on OpenShell (no NemoClaw recipe).
OpenShell toolchain at latest release; exact versions recorded in spike evidence.
Deny-by-default egress proven: disallowed egress fails; policy-allowed egress succeeds.
prime-agent daemon installs and runs healthily in-sandbox.
In-sandbox prime-agent session starts with a working persistent Python REPL.

Credential injection proven end-to-end via OpenShell providers using the operator's host-instance credentials; placeholders only in env; real model call succeeds; nothing on sandbox disk; fail-closed.
Committed re-runnable apply/check/validate/test artifacts per spike.
This inventory traces every requirement to its validator(s) and verdict document.
gbrain CLI installs and operates inside the sandbox.
Brain repo folder available in-sandbox (mechanism documented: openshell --upload).
Postgres 16 + pgvector runs in-sandbox, owned by the agent (PGDATA in /sandbox, no root/sudo).
gbrain serves search/query from in-sandbox Postgres + brain repo.
Postgres reachable from host at localhost:5433 (or documented forward). Non-blocking.
gbrain embeds via the AI Gateway through OpenShell L7 placeholder substitution; semantic search runs in-sandbox; key never on disk.
A git project exists in-sandbox as a committed folder (spawn target /sandbox/episode-target).
prime-agent session started via CLI with CWD scoped to the project; daemon spawn returns a session with cwd=project and kill reaps it cleanly.
Agent-driven spawn = same daemon create/kill channel as rlm(); RLM automatic-preparation race documented (workaround deferred per D6).
docs/derisk/ holds one verdict document per unknown (U1,U2,U3): what was proven, evidence, versions, verdict, constraint list.
Hard NO-GO protocol: stop all agentic execution, alert operator, wait for decision. (No hard NO-GO occurred; protocol documented, never invoked.)
Credential isolation preserved: no Keychain/browser-store access; no credential values in repo/logs/artifacts; only non-secret gateway config committed (D14).
All work landed: committed, pushed; beads prime-claw-f7k/6r8/tcf closed with verdict links.
Inference/credential setup configurable, not hardcoded (D14): provider/endpoint/baseUrl/credential shape parameterized (apply-phase1-providers.sh).
Single operator entry point bin/prime-claw owns the sandbox lifecycle: status, create, converge, build, validate, recover, destroy.
requirements.status: met (Slices 1-6; all verbs implemented; destroy confirm-gated + idempotent)
